content.description: Complete headlight wiring diagram showing headlight assembly, relays, switches, and electrical connections. The diagram shows dual headlights (HEAD LH and HEAD RH) with associated retract relay, light retainer relay, switches (OFF, O, TAIL, HEAD), and various wire connections labeled with numbers and wire codes (B-Y, O-B, O-W, etc.). The diagram includes fusible links and connections to battery and junction blocks.
